name: StockPKG Films
old_description: Nationally stocked film substrates. Innovative laminations. Large U.S. inventory selection. Sustainable solutions. Educated sales professionals. Industry leading pricing. Dependable products.
about:
StockPKG Films, headquartered in Omaha, Nebraska, was founded in 2008. The company began as a supplier of packaging films and has since expanded to offer custom lamination and precision slitting services from its own facilities.

The company produces and stocks a range of flexible packaging films including barrier, non-barrier, and metalized substrates, as well as proprietary pre-laminated Lightning Lam films featuring InkRite Technology for up to 99% ink adhesion. It also manufactures LidShield lidding films with options such as anti-fog, breathable perforations, and enhanced barrier constructions. In-house capabilities include precision slitting and rewinding to customer-specified widths, along with custom lamination. StockPKG operates a Make & Hold program that allows customers to lock in pricing and maintain inventory across multiple U.S. warehouses.

StockPKG serves printers and converters in the flexible packaging industry, with a focus on food packaging applications. Its clear BOPP films are stocked for common food packaging needs, while its Lightning Lam line addresses ink adhesion challenges in digital printing. Customers include businesses seeking quick lead times and consistent quality for both standard and custom film constructions.

The company differentiates itself through its InkRite Technology, which reduces ink consumption and improves print quality on laminated surfaces, and through its Make & Hold inventory strategy that helps mitigate raw-material price fluctuations. A team of sales representatives with decades of industry experience supports product selection and technical requirements.

name: Stratas Foods
old_description: Our company was founded in October 2008 as a 50/50 joint venture between ACH Food Companies and Archer Daniels Midland (ADM). ACH brought a strong portfolio of leading brands such as Frymax, Mazola ZT, and Sweetex, along with a robust retail bottled oils group. ADM contributed a vast North American production network, with access to global procurement, processing, and transportation resources. Together, these strengths positioned Stratas Foods as a leader in the food industry.
about:
Stratas Foods is headquartered in Cordova, Tennessee. The company was founded in October 2008 as a 50/50 joint venture between ACH Food Companies and Archer Daniels Midland (ADM). ACH contributed a portfolio of brands including Frymax, Mazola ZT, and Sweetex, along with a retail bottled oils group, while ADM brought a vast North American production network with global procurement, processing, and transportation resources.

Stratas Foods operates across three segments: Foodservice, Food Ingredients, and Retail. It manufactures a range of products including bakery fats, butter-flavored oils, dressings, frying oils, margarine, mayonnaise, mustard, olive oils, pan sprays, salad oils, vinegar, and cooking wines. The company also provides custom products and private label solutions for chain and distributor customers. Production facilities are located in Decatur, IL; Englewood, NJ; Fresno, CA; Memphis, TN; Nashville, TN; Quincy, IL; Valdosta, GA; and Dallas/Houston, TX, among others.

The company serves the Foodservice, Food Ingredients, and Retail Private Label markets in North America. Customers include restaurant chains, food manufacturers, and retail distributors seeking private label oils, sauces, and dressings.

Stratas Foods was formed to combine ACH's brand portfolio with ADM's production and supply chain infrastructure, positioning the joint venture as a leader in the North American fats, oils, mayonnaise, dressings, and sauces market.

name: Streamline Plastics
old_description: As a family-owned business since 1990 with 30+ years of experience, Streamline Plastics delivers consistent quality and dependable timelines.
about:
Streamline Plastics operates from Ogden, Utah, where it was founded in 1990 as a family-owned business. The company has remained under family ownership for over three decades, building its reputation on consistent quality and dependable timelines.

The shop provides plastic injection molding, blow molding, and a range of secondary services including part and mold design, mold building, packaging and assembly, kitting, bottle filling, and fulfillment. Its capabilities cover injection packaging, handled bottles in sizes such as 2.5‑gallon and 2.5‑gallon XL, and full fulfillment operations from kitting to shipping.

Customers include manufacturers who need reliable supply of molded components and finished goods; testimonials cite senior buyers, procurement directors, and sales directors who rely on Streamline for production-line parts, packaging, and assembled products. The company serves clients seeking to reduce inventory carrying costs and avoid production shutdowns caused by long lead times.

Streamline emphasizes clear communication throughout every project phase, transparent tracking from order to delivery, and quick turnaround times as its core differentiators. The firm positions itself as a partner that eliminates miscommunication, costly rework, and unpredictable supply chains.

name: Stromberg Metal Works Inc.
old_description: For over seven decades, contractors from all over the east coast have turned to Stromberg Metal Works, Inc. to meet all of their professional equipment and service needs. This is because, from the very beginning, our reputation has been solidly founded on the principle of making their own unique project requirements our own priority. As the years have passed, our employee-owned and operated organization has not only expanded for a larger geographical reach – serving a larger-than-ever community of professional contractors – but also in our service offerings. At Stromberg Metal Works, Inc., we take pride in our abilities to keep up with the latest technological trends in metal design, fabrication and installation, and continue to provide the most modern equipment to meet the needs of the evolving industrial landscape.
about:
Stromberg Metal Works, Inc. has operated from Beltsville, Maryland since 1940. The company began as a supplier for professional contractors across the East Coast and remains employee-owned and operated. Over more than seven decades it has expanded to four locations throughout Maryland, serving the Washington, D.C., Maryland, Virginia, and Pennsylvania region.

The firm provides metal design, fabrication, installation, and service for sheet metal and structural projects. Its shop capabilities include fully automated coil lines, plasma cutting tables, seam/MIG/TIG welding, mitre folding, cut-to-length processing, and in-house powder coating and paint booths. The company also produces spiral ductwork, Quikduc flange systems, coated ductwork, custom UL-rated boxes, and architectural ornamental metalwork. Engineering support covers shop drawings, automated estimation, and CAD drafting.

Primary customers are mechanical and sheet metal contractors working on commercial, institutional, and industrial projects. Stromberg specializes in laboratory, cleanroom, pharmaceutical, and data-center HVAC systems, where coated and spiral ductwork meet stringent airflow and corrosion requirements. The company also supplies architectural metal components such as custom hoods, panels, trim, and grilles for building envelopes and interior finishes.

Leadership emphasizes that employee ownership aligns incentives with project outcomes, and that continuous investment in automated coil and cutting equipment enables faster turnaround on accelerated schedules. The company states its founding principle was to make each contractor's unique project requirements its own priority.

name: Stryker Surgical Technologies
old_description: Together with our customers, we're committed to keeping caregivers and patients safe from harm. Through specialized focus, proven innovation and unwavering belief, we help transform healthcare for the better.
about:
Stryker Surgical Technologies, a division of Stryker Corporation, is headquartered in Irvine, California. The business unit focuses on surgical safety and education, though its founding year and ownership details are not publicly disclosed in the provided materials.

The unit develops and manufactures a portfolio of devices for the operating room, labor and delivery, and gastrointestinal suites. Key product lines include the SafeAir smoke evacuation system, SurgiCount+ and Triton for sponge counting and quantitative blood loss management, Neptune S and Neptune 3 fluid waste management systems with Smart Docking Stations, the PhotonBlade advanced monopolar energy platform, the POM procedural oxygen mask, and the Cactus smart sink system. The company also operates a Medical Education division that runs a Mobile Experience Lab and sponsors grants and scholarships through organizations such as AORN and AWHONN.

Customers include hospitals, surgical centers, and healthcare professionals across surgical, obstetric, and gastrointestinal specialties. The company cites engagement with thousands of clinicians through 55 mobile experience stops, 240 regional sales-rep-led events, and participation in 10 national trade shows in 2025, along with sponsorship of AORN Expo grants and AWHONN obstetric patient safety scholarships.

Stryker Surgical Technologies frames its differentiation around a "Journey to Zero" aspiration targeting zero splashes and spills, zero surgical smoke, zero retained sponges, zero maternal harm, zero hypoxic injuries, and zero lost polyps. The company states that its commitment to nurse development through education and collaborative learning communities is central to its mission.

name: Stylus Apparel
old_description: Since 2003, Stylus Apparel has provided factory direct apparel solutions to a number of distinguished clientele. We work with clothing lines and brands — both the young start-up brand and the well-established private label. We are contract garment manufacturers with the ability to create a large number of garments on demand. We work with corporate customers to deliver the highest quality apparel merchandise and employee workwear. We offer our customers apparel customization services from design to distribution, keeping every step in between under one roof and in one place.
about:
Founded in 2003 in Linden, New Jersey, Stylus Apparel began as a factory-direct apparel manufacturer serving clothing lines and corporate clients. The company operates its production facility minutes outside New York City.

Stylus Apparel provides contract garment manufacturing services including screen printing (plastisol, water-based, discharge, foil, and specialty inks), embroidery (direct, 3D puff, tackle twill, appliqué, patches, and distress techniques), sublimation printing (blank garment and cut-and-sew), and full cut-and-sew manufacturing with tech pack design, pattern grading, sampling, and production. The company also produces woven fabric labels. All work is performed in-house at its state-of-the-art cut-and-sew facility, which the company says has capacity for large volumes.

The company serves clothing brands ranging from start-up lines to established private labels, as well as corporate customers needing custom merchandise and employee uniforms. Examples include young start-up brands, well-established private labels, and corporate clients ordering screen-printed T-shirts or embroidered polo shirts for managers.

Stylus Apparel emphasizes its factory-direct model, with all production kept under one roof from design to distribution. It highlights 100% American labor and a "Made in USA" commitment, along with more than 30 years of cut-and-sew experience among its team.

name: Subsalve USA
old_description: Since 1977, we have provided solutions and expertise for aircraft recovery, ship, yacht, and boat salvage, marine construction, offshore oilfield diving, and explosive ordnance disposal.
about:
Subsalve USA is based in North Kingstown, Rhode Island, and was founded in 1977 by Richard Fryburg. The company began as a specialist in engineered inflatables for marine and military applications, and in 2017 it became part of Performance Inflatables Co LLC.

The company designs and manufactures a range of engineered inflatables, including underwater lift bags, inflation hose assemblies, station manifolds, inflation yoke assemblies, and acoustic and remote tablet actuation systems. It maintains an inventory of standard products and offers custom design services for specialized applications. Notable projects include supplying more than 600 tons of lift bags for the 2001 installation of the Spiegel Grove artificial reef and supporting James Cameron’s Deepsea Challenger mission in 2012.

Subsalve serves industries such as aircraft recovery, ship and boat salvage, marine construction, offshore oilfield diving, explosive ordnance disposal, pipeline and tunnel construction, proofload testing, public safety, research, and shipyard operations. Its customers include the U.S. Department of Defense, all branches of the U.S. Armed Forces, NASA, the FBI, private-sector companies, and governments of more than 30 foreign countries.

The company differentiates itself by using polyurethane-coated fabrics—nylon, polyester, and Kevlar—in all its lift bags, which it says provides superior puncture, abrasion, and chemical resistance. All products are made in the USA, tested before shipping, and carry a one-year warranty. Subsalve holds compliance with IMCA D-016-AIRBAGS, ABS, and U.S. Department of Defense standards, and holds multiple patents for its designs.

name: Sugar Hollow Solar
old_description: Founded by Doug Ager and his cousin, we’re rooted in four generations of land stewardship in the southern Appalachians.
about:
Sugar Hollow Solar is based in Asheville, North Carolina, and was founded in 2010 by cousins Doug Ager and Phelps Clarke. The company traces its roots to four generations of land stewardship in the southern Appalachians, with the founders having grown up on the family farm along Sugar Hollow Road in Fairview.

The firm provides full-service solar energy solutions, including design, installation, and maintenance of photovoltaic systems, battery backup storage, and electric-vehicle charging equipment. With a team of more than 50 employees, Sugar Hollow has completed over 1,000 installations across Western North Carolina and Upstate South Carolina, handling every step from site assessment to final commissioning.

Its customers span residential homeowners, commercial property owners, and nonprofit organizations seeking to reduce energy costs and carbon emissions. The company has installed systems for private homes, businesses, and community-focused nonprofits throughout the region.

Sugar Hollow distinguishes itself through its B Corp certification and membership in the Amicus Solar Cooperative, reflecting a commitment to social and environmental responsibility. The founders' stated mission is to transition the Southern Appalachian community to clean energy with honesty, reliability, and expertise, prioritizing long-term relationships over short-term profit.

old_description: Suminoe Textile of America (STA) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Suminoe Textile Ltd. which originated in Osaka Japan over 125 years ago. STA began operations in April 2003 in our state-of-the-art manufacturing facility in Gaffney SC. about:
Suminoe Textile of America (STA) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Suminoe Textile Ltd., a Japanese company with roots in Osaka dating back over 125 years. STA began operations in April 2003 at a purpose-built manufacturing facility in Gaffney, South Carolina, placing it in the heart of the Carolina textile corridor where it draws on the area's deep pool of textile expertise.

The company produces automobile interior furnishings at full scale for the North American market, focusing on seat fabrics, floor mats, and carpets. Its finishing capabilities include printing, etching, napping, and sueding, applied to automotive textile substrates to meet OEM specifications.

STA serves the automotive industry, supplying interior textile components to vehicle manufacturers and tier-one suppliers across North America. Its product lineup centers on automotive fabrics and carpet systems for passenger vehicles, with all production occurring at its Gaffney plant.

The company cites its ISO/TS16949 certification from TÜV as evidence of its quality commitment, and emphasizes its strategic location in a region with deep textile manufacturing heritage as a competitive advantage.

about:
Summit Electric Supply, based in Gonzales, Louisiana, was founded in 1977. The company began with a focus on supplying electrical products to local businesses and has grown into a multi-segment distributor serving a wide geographic area. No founder names or ownership details are publicly disclosed.

Today the company stocks and distributes a comprehensive line of electrical materials — circuit protection, wire and cable, tools, wiring devices, lighting, connectors, enclosures, conduit and fittings, lamps and ballasts, hardware, and power distribution equipment.

Summit’s customer base spans commercial, residential, industrial, institutional, OEM, and marine sectors. Testimonials from a supply chain manager, a business development lead, an electrical foreman, and a CEO illustrate the range of roles that rely on the company for project quoting, technical support, and rapid material fulfillment.

The firm positions itself on three pillars — responsive, credible, reliable — promising that time-sensitive orders are met without delay, that its product quality and service reputation are unmatched, and that its industry experts are available around the clock to keep projects on track.
